Task: In lib.rs, `max_run` computes the largest sum of any contiguous run, but the running total is wrong: `here = here.max(v)` discards the accumulated sum instead of extending it. It should be `here = v.max(here + v)` — either start a new run at v, or extend the previous one by v. Make that change so the tests pass.

The change is verified by running: rustc --test --edition 2021 -o t_stated.exe test.rs && ./t_stated.exe
Make that command exit 0. Do not edit any test files.
